description: This file defines structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes related to Git transport mechanisms, including options, transport retrieval, connection management, and push operations.

methods.name: transport_summary_width
methods.description: Returns the width of the transport summary display based on refs.

methods.name: transport_get
methods.description: Returns a transport object suitable for the given URL and remote.

methods.name: is_transport_allowed
methods.description: Checks if a transport type is permitted by the environment.

methods.name: transport_check_allowed
methods.description: Checks and enforces transport allowance, terminating if not allowed.

methods.name: transport_set_option
methods.description: Sets an option for the transport, returns 0 if used successfully.

methods.name: transport_set_verbosity
methods.description: Sets verbosity level for transport output.

methods.name: transport_push
methods.description: Pushes refs to a remote via the transport, with rejection reasons.

methods.name: transport_ls_refs_options_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with transport ls-refs options.

methods.name: transport_get_remote_refs
methods.description: Retrieves refs from a remote.

methods.name: transport_get_remote_bundle_uri
methods.description: Retrieves bundle URI(s) from a remote.

methods.name: transport_get_hash_algo
methods.description: Fetches the hash algorithm used by the remote.

methods.name: transport_fetch_refs
methods.description: Fetches refs from the remote.

methods.name: transport_unlock_pack
methods.description: Unlocks all packfiles locked by the transport.

methods.name: transport_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the transport.

methods.name: transport_anonymize_url
methods.description: Returns an anonymized version of the URL.

methods.name: transport_take_over
methods.description: Transfers control of the transport to a child process.

methods.name: transport_connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection for the transport.

methods.name: transport_helper_init
methods.description: Initializes a transport helper.

methods.name: bidirectional_transfer_loop
methods.description: Performs a bidirectional data transfer loop.

methods.name: transport_update_tracking_ref
methods.description: Updates tracking references on remote.

methods.name: transport_refs_pushed
methods.description: Checks if refs have been pushed.

methods.name: transport_print_push_status
methods.description: Prints status of push operation.

methods.name: reject_atomic_push
methods.description: Rejects an atomic push based on refs and mirror mode.

methods.name: parse_transport_option
methods.description: Parses transport options from config variables.
